log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Incineroar
Floette used Light of Ruin → Mamoswine

decisions.rationale: Lead Metagross + Incineroar with Mega Metagross as intended Mega. Incineroar provides crucial Intimidate to weaken physical threats (Dragapult, Annihilape, Arcanine-Hisui) and Fake Out for tempo control. Metagross can Mega Evolve for Tough Claws-boosted Meteor Mash/Ice Punch. Backline Meowscarada applies fast special pressure with Protean Flower Trick, while Mamoswine's Ice Shard cleans up Dragons and provides Earthquake/Rock Slide spread damage. This core handles opponent's physical-heavy roste
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs physical-heavy team with Choice Scarf Dragapult and Mega Floette-Eternal threat. Intimidate + Sun core weakens their physical attackers. Mega Metagross key for handling Fairy/Ice types. Watch for Floette Mega Evolution timing - Light of Ruin 140 power is devastating. Maushold Population Bomb + Wide Lens is high-risk high-reward threat. Arcanine-Hisui Rock Head means no recoil on HeadSmash/FlareBlitz. Plan: use Intimidate cycles, control speed with priority moves, and preserve Mega Metagross for late-game cleanup.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Floette. Lead Floette+Maushold: T1 Friend Guard Follow Me shields Mega LoR into Incin/Torkoal/Metagross while FG softens spreads. Back Arcanine (Rock Head LO Head Smash/Blitz/ES) + sash Adapt Basc (Wave Crash/Last Respects) beat sun, Mamo, and late Metagross; Ghost chip + redirect out-offenses their wincons.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp sun (Torkoal Charcoal Drought) + Mega Metagross TC with Incin FakeOut/Intim, Meow LO Protean, Mamo sash, Rotom Scarf. We: Mega Floette Fairy pressure + Maushold FG redirect, RH LO H-Arcanine, Ghosts (Pult scarf/Annih Defiant/Basc sash Adapt) pressure Mega/Incin; Wave Crash covers Tork/Mamo. No weather; out-offense via FG/redirect. Priority targets: Torkoal, Mega Gross, Meow. Future: hard-hitting STAB, clear spe tiers.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolve Metagross immediately for Tough Claws boost on Meteor Mash targeting Floette-Eternal (SE 2x). Incineroar Fake Out on Maushold prevents Population Bomb and FollowMe disruption. Maushold's Speed range (144-179) may outspeed Metagross (134), so Fake Out ensures we control the turn. Floette's Speed (112-144) likely moves after Mega Metagross (143-178), allowing us to hit first. This pressures their Mega immediately while neutralizing Maushold's multi-hit threat.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Floette-Eternal + Maushold with Wide Lens. Intimidate already applied (-1 Atk both foes). Floette has Light of Ruin 140bp - dangerous even through resistances. Maushold Population Bomb + Wide Lens is primary physical threat. Mega Metagross key for late-game; consider timing vs their backline threats (Dragapult Scarf, Arcanine-Hisui Rock Head). Incineroar Sitrus Berry + Intimidate provides physical bulk cycling. Watch for Floette Mega timing - FlowerVeil prevents stat drops on Grass allies.

decisions.rationale: Metagross Meteor Mash guarantees KO on Floette at 33% HP (74-166% dmg). Switching to Meowscarada (192 Speed) outspeeds both foes; if Floette falls, Meowscarada handles Maushold. If Floette Protects, Meowscarada still moves first next turn. Mamoswine's Focus Sash is less valuable since Metagross should remove the Fairy threat this turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Floette-Mega + Maushold Wide Lens. Intimidate applied turn 1. Floette Light of Ruin 140bp dangerous through resistances. Maushold Population Bomb primary physical threat. Mega Metagross key for late-game; time carefully vs Dragapult Scarf and Arcanine-Hisui. Incineroar Sitrus cycling valuable. Watch for Floette Protect patterns and Maushold FollowMe redirection. Meowscarada speed tier (192) outruns their entire backline except Scarf Dragapult.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 2 (Incineroar) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Incin FakeOut threatens flinch; Follow Me draws it and redirects Gross Steel. Mega LoR into Incin pressures the pivot/FakeOut user through Sitrus while FG softens spread/priority. Avoid free SE Steel into Floette.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp sun (Torkoal Charcoal Drought) + Mega Metagross TC with Incin FakeOut/Intim, Meow LO Protean, Mamo sash, Rotom Scarf. We: Mega Floette Fairy pressure + Maushold FG redirect, RH LO H-Arcanine, Basc sash Adapt pressure Mega/Incin; Wave Crash covers Tork/Mamo. No weather; out-offense via FG/redirect. Priority targets: Torkoal, Mega Gross, Meow. Future: hard-hitting STAB, clear spe tiers. Incin Sitrus Impish FakeOut/Parting/Blitz/Protect.

decisions.rationale: Floette's Light of Ruin guarantees OHKO on Meowscarada (151-311%). Meteor Mash on Floette does 74-166% (guaranteed KO at 33% HP if it hits). Meowscarada Protects to avoid LoR. If Maushold FollowMes, Meteor Mash redirects to Maushold (42-98.7%) - still strong damage. If Meteor Mash connects, Floette is eliminated and we gain massive advantage. Bullet Punch (33.7-76.5%) isn't a guaranteed KO at 33% HP and is also redirected by FollowMe (+2 > +1).
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Floette-Mega + Maushold Wide Lens. Floette Light of Ruin 140bp is lethal to Meowscarada (guaranteed OHKO). Maushold FollowMe (+2 priority) redirects single-target moves - both Meteor Mash and Flower Trick are vulnerable. Meteor Mash 90% accuracy is the main KO tool on Floette; Bullet Punch minimum roll may not KO at ~33% HP. Meowscarada Speed 192 outruns all except Scarf Dragapult. Preserve Mega Metagross for late-game; avoid unnecessary exposure to Dragapult Scarf Dragon Darts or Arcanine-Hisui. Incineroar Sitrus cycling valuable for future games. Watch for Maushold Tidy Up setup turns.

decisions.rationale: Floette 33% dies to any SE/priority or LO hit; Protect+Follow Me forces them to hit Maushold or waste turns while we keep Fairy Aura pressure and FG. Next turn can Tidy/clean.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp sun (Torkoal Charcoal Drought) + Mega Metagross TC with Incin FakeOut/Intim, Meow LO Protean, Mamo sash, Rotom Scarf. We: Mega Floette Fairy pressure + Maushold FG redirect, RH LO H-Arcanine, Basc sash Adapt pressure Mega/Incin; Wave Crash covers Tork/Mamo. No weather; out-offense via FG/redirect. Priority targets: Torkoal, Mega Gross, Meow. Future: hard-hitting STAB, clear spe tiers. Incin Sitrus Impish FakeOut/Parting/Blitz/Protect. Meowscarada LifeOrb Protean Timid revealed.

decisions.rationale: Meowscarada's Protect has 50% success rate after consecutive use; failure = Light of Ruin OHKO. Switching to Mamoswine guarantees Meowscarada preservation. Bullet Punch (33.7-76.5% dmg) KOs Floette at 33% HP if not redirected by Follow Me. If Follow Me is used, Bullet Punch hits Maushold instead, and Mamoswine enters safely with Focus Sash to tank any hit. This line avoids the coin-flip Protect while maintaining offensive pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Floette-Mega + Maushold Follow Me redirect into Light of Ruin nuke. Meowscarada Protect success rate drops to 50% on consecutive use—avoid relying on it. Bullet Punch KOs Floette at 33% HP (min 33.7% > 33% remaining). Mamoswine Focus Sash provides reliable emergency switch-in. Preserve Incineroar Sitrus for future games. Meteor Mash 90% accuracy has missed twice; prefer Bullet Punch reliability. Watch for opponent switching Floette out when threatened to bring in Dragapult Scarf or Arcanine-Hisui.

decisions.rationale: Floette 33% dies to BP or LO FlowerTrick. Follow Me +2 first redirects both; LoR FairyAura 2x KOs Meow through most Protect odds. Maus lives redirected Steel/Grass.

Meteor Mash on Floette guarantees KO (74-166% > 33% remaining). If Maushold Follow Me redirects, Meteor Mash hits Maushold instead (42-98% > 32% remaining) - either way one foe KOs. Mamoswine Protects to avoid Giga Drain (SE) and preserve Focus Sash. Metagross tanks resisted Light of Ruin (48-81%) if needed. Sets up favorable 2v1 next turn.
decisions.notebook: Bullet Punch does NOT reliably KO Floette at 33% HP (33.7-76.5%, estimate says cannot OHKO) - use Meteor Mash for guaranteed KOs. Meteor Mash 90% accuracy has missed twice but damage output necessary. Opponent pattern: Follow Me + Light of Ruin; expect continuation or Protect Floette. Maushold Follow Me (+2) outruns all priority +1 moves. Focus Sash on Mamoswine preserved for emergency. Preserve Incineroar Sitrus for future games. Meowscarada Protect success drops on consecutive use.

decisions.rationale: Both actives die to BP/EQ from 33%. Follow Me forces sac on Maushold and lets Arcanine enter free vs Gross+Mamo; send Basc after. Avoid LoR recoil suicide and unprotected Giga Drain into EQ revenge.

Mega Gross Jolly MeteorMash/IcePunch/BulletPunch/Protect.

decisions.rationale: Maushold dead; bring Basc sash Adapt. Floette 33% dies to any Meta hit/+1 Mash; Basc lives priority, pressures both with LastRespects/WaveCrash, covers Mamo. Arc can ES/Blitz next.

Mega Gross Jolly MeteorMash/IcePunch/BulletPunch/Protect. Gross +1 Atk after KO Maus.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine Earthquake 4x on Arcanine-Hisui is near-guaranteed KO. Metagross Meteor Mash into Basculegion (0.5x) forces Focus Sash, then Earthquake's spread damage finishes it. Metagross resists Ground (0.5x) so ally damage is minimal. This removes both threats in one turn if damage connects.
decisions.notebook: Basculegion holds Focus Sash - will survive one KO hit. Arcanine Life Orb recoil accumulates. Earthquake 4x on Arcanine-Hisui (Fire/Rock) is primary KO tool. Metagross +1 Attack Meteor Mash necessary for guaranteed KOs despite 90% accuracy. Opponent favors Follow Me + Light of Ruin pattern; with Maushold fainted, expect direct attacks or Protects. Preserve Meowscarada for late-game cleanup. Incineroar Sitrus preserved for future games.

decisions.rationale: Mamo sash + ThickFat; Flare Blitz forces sash then Basc can finish later. LR (100BP Adapt) into +1 Gross is strong Ghost SE. Arc outspeeds Mamo range often; avoid EQ 4x by KOing/forcing sash on Mamo while pressuring Gross. Floette 33% back.

decisions.rationale: Only Floette left at 33%; must send into one slot and pass the other. Slot a vs Gross is fine; Fairy Aura LoR pressures both after.

decisions.rationale: Metagross +1 Meteor Mash does 74-166% into Floette at 33% HP—guaranteed KO if it hits (90% acc). Mamoswine Protect guards against Giga Drain (37-103% OHKO range) if Meteor misses. Metagross outspeeds Floette (178 vs 122-154). Ice Punch cannot KO (20-46%). This line maximizes KO probability while protecting against the worst-case miss scenario.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors aggressive Light of Ruin over Protect when pressured. Floette-Mega Fairy Aura boosts Fairy moves but irrelevant here. Metagross +1 Attack crucial for guaranteed KOs. Preserve Meowscarada (100% HP, Life Orb) as late-game cleaner. Mamoswine Focus Sash intact—emergency survival tool. Opponent's remaining bench: Dragapult (Choice Scarf), Annihilape (Leftovers)—both unrevealed this game. Track Floette's Light of Ruin PP (used 2, likely 3-4 remaining).

decisions.rationale: Floette 33% dies to any prio Steel/Ice; Protect is only safe play. Basc fainted so pass. Live to force Mamo/Gross into awkward range next.

decisions.rationale: Metagross +1 Bullet Punch is priority, guaranteeing Floette-Mega KO before it acts regardless of speed or Protect. Mamoswine Rock Slide pressures any switch-in (Dragapult 4x weak, Annihilape neutral) and can flinch. Floette's Protect has reduced success rate, but Bullet Punch bypasses it entirely. Preserves Metagross at 30% HP and Mamoswine's Focus Sash for late game.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors aggressive Light of Ruin over Protect when pressured. Floette-Mega Protect success rate drops after consecutive use. Metagross +1 Attack from Meteor Mash KO is critical win condition. Meowscarada (100% HP, Life Orb, Timid) is late-game cleaner—preserve. Mamoswine Focus Sash intact for emergency survival. Opponent bench: Dragapult (Choice Scarf, Infiltrator), Annihilape (Leftovers, Defiant)—both unrevealed. Track Floette Light of Ruin PP (used 2 of 5). Incineroar Intimidate already triggered this game.

decisions.rationale: Floette 33% dies to BP or IceShard+anything. Mamo sash means LoR leaves 1HP; Giga Drain 2x heals and chips through sash for next. Protect fail-prone. Pass only on fainted slot.

reflections.summary: Won due to Metagross securing a +1 Attack boost and Mamoswine’s Earthquake delivering a critical spread KO, but the team preview was flawed: the selected four lacked speed control or Follow Me disruption, making the win overly reliant on Metagross’s accuracy against a redirect-heavy Fairy/Fire core.
reflections.adjustment: In preview, replace a slower pivot with a dedicated speed-control or Taunt user to neutralize Maushold’s Follow Me, preventing Floette-Mega from freely firing Light of Ruin and reducing reliance on Metagross’s accuracy.
reflections.notebook: Opponent prioritizes aggressive Light of Ruin over Protect when pressured. Maushold Follow Me is the linchpin for enabling Floette-Mega and Arcanine-Hisui; disrupting it is essential. Floette-Mega Protect success rate drops after consecutive use. Opponent bench: Dragapult (Choice Scarf, Infiltrator) and Annihilape (Leftovers, Defiant) remain unrevealed. Metagross +1 Attack via Meteor Mash is a proven win condition; Mamoswine Earthquake excels at spread KOs. Future plan: Incorporate dedicated speed control or redirection disruption in team preview; preserve Meowscarada for late-game cleanup; prepare for potential Scarf Dragapult or Defiant Annihilape switches.

reflections.summary: Lost due to unsuitable preview: Mega Floette + Maushold into Mega Metagross/Incin/Mamo (Bullet Punch + Ice Shard priority and Fake Out shutting redirect) left Fairy Aura LR-recoil fragile with no clean wincon after the T5 EQ double KO.
reflections.adjustment: Change the bring vs Gross+Mamo cores—bench Mega Floette, lead Basculegion/Arcanine pressure instead, and only mega Floette if Torkoal/Rotom appear or Gross is already weakened.
reflections.notebook: Matchup: opp sun (Torkoal Charcoal Drought) + Mega Metagross TC with Incin FakeOut/Intim/Sitrus Impish Parting/Blitz/Protect, Meow LO Protean Timid FlowerTrick/DarkPulse/GrassKnot/Protect, Mamo Jolly sash ThickFat IceShard/EQ/RockSlide/Protect, Rotom Scarf. Gross Jolly Mega Mash/IcePunch/BulletPunch/Protect. We: Mega Floette Fairy pressure + Maushold FG redirect, RH LO H-Arcanine, Basc sash Adapt (Wave Crash covers Tork/Mamo, Last Respects). Priority targets Tork/Gross/Meow. Opp g1 brought Gross/Incin/Meow/Mamo (no sun/scarf). LR recoil heavy under Fairy Aura. Plan: avoid Mega Floette vs Gross+Mamo priority; prefer Basc/Arcanine and force Tork/Rotom reveals.
